FAQ.text: Cancel anytime in the customer portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current monthly billing period. There are no partial-period refunds unless required by law.

FAQ.text: Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram are live. X and Threads are built and await developer approvals. LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook are planned and depend on platform reviews. None of these upcoming networks has a confirmed release date. See /roadmap for current status.

FAQ.text: Does my client need an account to approve posts?

FAQ.label: Answer 5
FAQ.text: No. On Agency, send a review link so your client can approve or request changes without signing in. Keep the link private: anyone with access to it may be able to review the post.

FAQ.label: Question 6
FAQ.text: Is my data hosted in Germany or the EU?

FAQ.label: Answer 6
FAQ.text: Postial’s application data is hosted with Hetzner in Germany. Payment processing, optional Google sign-in, and connected social networks may involve processing outside the EU. See our Privacy Policy for details.

FAQ.label: Answer 7
FAQ.text: Agency includes REST API and webhooks. The n8n node awaits npm publication. Automations use the same brand limits and connected-network permissions as your account.
